Dr. Vikas Singh: Professional Profile

Cosmetic dermatology · hair transplantation · longevity & regenerative medicine

Home/About/Dr. Vikas Singh

A global perspective

A career built on innovation

Dr. Vikas Singh is a cosmetic dermatologist, hair transplant surgeon and longevity & regenerative medicine expert.

For more than 20 years he has worked across the evolving fields of cosmetology, dermatology, hair transplantation, anti-ageing and regenerative medicine. His stated philosophy moves beyond conventional cosmetic treatment toward a broader idea of healthspan — bringing appearance, regeneration and longevity into a single conversation about how a patient looks and how they age.
